proposals.title: Unify evidence-level vocabulary across research registries
proposals.context: Inherited registries used four incompatible vocabularies (DISCOVERED/DOCUMENTED/..., source-inspected/mock-tested/live-verified, README_CLAIM/DOCUMENTED_API/UNCERTAIN, SOURCE_INSPECTED_NOT_EXECUTED). "live-verified" was applied to bounded private-session observations.

alternatives.option: Seven-level enum README_CLAIM..RELEASE_APPROVED plus separate live_observation/audit fields
cons: old registries remain in legacy form

proposals.trade_offs: Conservative capping lowers the apparent maturity of the Pancake tag/settings rows (was live-verified, now SYNTHETIC_TESTED with live_observation).
proposals.recommendation: Adopt the seven-level enum for new registries; keep legacy files read-only; validator enforces it.
proposals.migration_impact: Docs/validator only; no product code or schema change.

proposals.title: PH4 Pancake ingestion path ordering
proposals.context: Three candidate paths: official Pancake Chat Public API + POS webhooks/API (documented, no credential yet); observed Phoenix socket (internal protocol, rights UNKNOWN); first-party browser companion (synthetic-tested, consent-based).

alternatives.option: Official Public API polling + POS webhooks first

proposals.trade_offs: Latency vs licensing/continuity risk; manual fallback remains regardless.
proposals.recommendation: Request one pilot-page Public API credential and a dedicated test POS shop; implement read polling + POS webhook receiver; keep socket and companion as research-only gap detectors.
proposals.migration_impact: New adapter behind existing envelope/receipt tables; no canonical change.

proposals.title: First ads provider for read-only acquisition context
proposals.context: Meta Marketing Insights, TikTok Marketing reporting and Google Ads GAQL are all DOCUMENTED_API with official SDK source inspected; none has a named test account.
proposals.trade_offs: Pick by pilot customer channel mix, not SDK convenience.
proposals.recommendation: Choose the provider used by the first pilot workspace; read-only daily spend + IDs; attribution stays UNKNOWN.
proposals.migration_impact: Append-only observation table keyed by provider/account/object/interval/config.

proposals.title: Outcome export to ad platforms (CAPI / TikTok Events / Google Data Manager)
proposals.context: Export of verified outcomes is a provider write; Google directs new offline conversion work to Data Manager API; legacy upload compatibility is conditional.
proposals.trade_offs: Exports could be misread as attribution; must remain namespaced measurement assertions.
proposals.recommendation: Defer until MM-1 RFC and consent review; if started, Data Manager (not legacy upload) with human-approved batches.
proposals.migration_impact: Outbound job + audit records; no canonical attribution field.

proposals.title: Background job runtime
proposals.context: Webhook intake, polling and retries need durable jobs. Candidates: PostgreSQL job/outbox table, BullMQ (Redis), Temporal.
proposals.recommendation: PostgreSQL job/outbox first; ADAPT BullMQ idempotency patterns; reject Temporal/Kafka for now.
proposals.migration_impact: One migration adding job table (owned by persistence agent).

proposals.title: Authentication/authorization building blocks
proposals.context: App auth is a bootstrap stub; lead-scoped policy is in-process.

alternatives.option: External OIDC (Keycloak/ZITADEL/Ory) + jose verifier + in-process policy port

proposals.recommendation: jose-based verifier behind AuthContextResolver with a provider-neutral IdP; keep policy in-process; IdP roles never grant lead access.
proposals.migration_impact: Auth module only; membership tables owned by platform.

proposals.title: Connector platform vs narrow ports
proposals.context: Nango/Airbyte offer connection lifecycle and sync frameworks under ELv2.
proposals.recommendation: Narrow ports until a second OAuth provider is live.

proposals.title: Zalo channel route
proposals.context: Zalo OA is official (docs unreadable in checks); Zalo Personal is a private session route.

alternatives.option: OA adapter after official contract verification

proposals.recommendation: OA only; reject personal route; obtain official docs + test OA before any code.

proposals.title: First CRM target spike
proposals.context: Twenty is the canonical ID-2 example; HubSpot has the strongest official SDK evidence; Chatwoot is an inbox not a CRM.
proposals.recommendation: Spike against the CRM the first pilot customer uses; external IDs only, no field ownership until ID-2 RFC.

proposals.title: Policy on observed internal / reverse-engineered protocols
proposals.context: Pancake Phoenix, Meta DGW/MQTT, TikTok Webcast and Zalo personal are observed or community reverse-engineered.

alternatives.option: Research-only with gap detection; never production intake

proposals.recommendation: Research-only; promotion requires written provider permission artifact.
